title: 舞会

series.next: Season one is over. 赵奶奶 has started a new group, 金桂苑相亲角, and added you.

setting: 金桂苑's square, Saturday, 8 pm. The estate's dance night. Fairy lights, folding stools, and a waltz.

wu.name: 吴阿姨
wu.en: 3号楼: knows someone who saw it

fang.name: 方阿姨
fang.en: 7号楼: dancing slowly, for her knee

steps.narr: 金桂苑's dance night. Fairy lights over the square, and two hundred neighbours on folding stools.

steps.zh: 就一句话，我打了一个小时。
steps.en: One line. It took me an hour to type.

else.narr: 方阿姨 takes the mic, and reads out one line from her phone.

steps.narr: The waltz. 老周 and 方阿姨, slowly, for her knee. Nobody on the square says a word.
Then three aunties turn round on their stools, together, and look at you.

steps.en: Young neighbour, what about you? Seeing anyone?

steps.zh: 我认识一个好孩子，介绍给你！
steps.en: I know a lovely young person. I'll introduce you!

say.en: Deflect it, nicely: nobody, and you'll see when the time comes.
answers: 阿姨，没有啦，到时候再说吧。
say.gloss: Nobody! We'll see when the time comes.
say.tip: 对象 duìxiàng = a partner, anyone you're seeing. 没有啦 = nope (啦 softens it). 到时候再说 = we'll see.

fail.en: Well, are you or aren't you?

answers: 没有啦，缘分到时候再说吧。
4.gloss: Nobody! Let's leave it to fate, and see.
4.tip: 缘分 yuánfèn = the luck that brings two people together.

say.en: Tease them back: they're in more of a hurry than you are!
answers: 阿姨们，你们比我还着急！
say.gloss: Aunties, you're in more of a hurry than I am!
say.tip: 比我还…… = even more ... than me. 着急 zháojí = anxious, in a hurry.

ok.en: The one in a hurry is me.

answers: 阿姨们，你们怎么比我还着急呀！
4.gloss: Aunties, how come you're in more of a hurry than I am?

steps.zh: 老周和方阿姨的事，是我传出去的。
steps.en: That rumour about 老周 and 方阿姨: I started it.

steps.zh: 他们俩，一个比一个害羞。不推一把，再等十年。
steps.en: Those two are each shyer than the other. Without a push, they'd have waited another ten years.
I've been a matchmaker for forty years.

steps.zh: 所以那张照片……那些语音……
steps.en: So that photo... all those voice notes...

say.en: Thank her: she's amazing. Or tease her: so it was you!
say.tip: 厉害 lìhai = amazing, formidable: the highest praise for a schemer.

alts.en: Or: tease her, so it was you!

answers: 赵奶奶，您真厉害，谢谢您！
4.gloss: 赵奶奶, you're amazing. Thank you!

answers: 原来是您！您才是最大的瓜！
alts.gloss: So it was you! You're the biggest gossip of all!

steps.en: The square dances until ten. 赵奶奶 has already written down three names, and one of them is yours. Season one ends here. 🍉

else.en: By morning the whole estate knows who started it. 赵奶奶 doesn't mind one bit. Season one ends here. 🍉
